description: Which of our repositories a lead's issue goes to (state/leads.mjs repoFor). components[lane][component] first, then lanes[lane], then default. Only repositories in repos can be named; the GitHub App must be installed on each with issues: write (docs/OPERATIONS.md, "Leads"). live-probe's install and start stages run in the mcp-surface-corpus sandbox and driver; its resolve, list and probe stages are mcp-check's.
